message: minecraft:deepslate_bricks is in blocks already, as "minecraft:deepslate_bricks": each block has one set of rules
"Not An Id" isn't one of the game's blocks: an id like "minecraft:stone", or a tag like "#minecraft:logs"
hardness is how long it takes to mine: 0 or more, or -1 for a block nobody can break
blocks lists none of the game's blocks, so these rules are for nothing
requiresTool: false can't make the game's own drops fall for the wrong tool: the game keeps its rule for its loot. Name drops of the project's to drop them for any tool
minecraft:deepslate_bricks already has the rules of game block "bricks": each block has one set of rules
